headline: Climate Units
title: Heat Furnace and Cooling Unit | Plus the Sunlamp | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Some Homeland recipes need the right climate. At R V level seven you can place the Heat Furnace, which uses the Fire ability to give heat, and the Cooling Unit, which uses Ice to cool. The Sunlamp comes at R V level nine and uses Light. These units only help facilities inside their range, so place them close. Do not put a cool crop next to a furnace. Which one do you build first? Comment below!
description: In Aniimo's Homeland the Heat Furnace and Cooling Unit unlock at RV level 7 (Fire and Ice workers) and the Sunlamp at RV level 9 (Light). They only affect facilities inside their range.
joke: A furnace next to my frost crop, because chaos is a farming strategy.
